messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Control plane heartbeat missing in sa-east1 (scl1). ~37 nodes non-responsive. Detected at 2026-04-02T09:05:21Z
priya (oncall): Got it — investigating now. @marco can you check BGP/flaps with the provider?
alex (enginfra): Seeing API 503s from the region for ~10m. k8s control-plane logs show repeated 'raft heartbeat timeout' and etcd leader re-elections.
marco (neteng): I see large route withdraws 09:03–09:07 from provider, multiple prefixes affected. Opening cloud NOC ticket INC-2345 and pinging their oncall.
ops-bot: Runbook step 1 acknowledged by priya. Health check: ```curl -s https://sre.internal/health/sa-east1 | jq .``` Output: {"control_plane":"unreachable","api_gateway":"unhealthy"}
sara (sre): We should prepare for traffic shift. sa-east2 has some spare capacity but not infinite — dedicated pools in sa-east1 will be impacted during migration.
priya (oncall): Failover checklist: 1) suspend scheduling to sa-east1, 2) reroute edge -> sa-east2/sfo1, 3) scale up compute in target regions. Who can run the edge cutover?
alex (enginfra): I'll take edge. Preparing route change command now: ```redwoodctl route set --from=sa-east1 --to=sa-east2 --weight=100 --dry-run=false``` Starting canary at 10%.
marco (neteng): Provider reports an unplanned maintenance on fabric — they didn't notify. Their NOC says investigating a fabric partition.
priya (oncall): Canary 10% started at 09:12:40Z. Monitoring.
monitoring-bot: Canary traffic 10% -> sa-east2 initiated. Requests hitting sa-east1 still show ~40% error rate.
sara (sre): Heads up: cross-region egress will spike costs while we shift. Alerting finance-ops and tagging telemetry.
incident-manager: Please update status page: set region(south-america) = degraded. @marketing for customer comms?
ops-bot: Paging dedicated-customers-southamerica oncall.
alex (enginfra): Autoscaler in sa-east2 increased +12 nodes; provisioning ETA ~6m. Suggest enabling reserved burst pool to cover immediate capacity needs.
priya (oncall): Enable reserved pool now — do it.
marco (neteng): To stop routing loops, blackholing affected AS path at the edge for specific prefixes. Applied temporary community `no-export` on 200.45.0.0/19.
sara (sre): Pause any automated etcd leader moves; KV store under heavy contention. Observability shows high disk IO on masters.
monitoring-bot: Partial control plane restoration observed for subset of masters at 09:27:02Z. Full control plane still unstable.
priya (oncall): Quick status check: if control plane not stable in 20m we start ordered region evacuation. Confirm?
alex (enginfra): Disk IO contention points to underlying host storage — opening infra ticket with host vendor linking logs + dmesg.
marco (neteng): Cloud NOC reports fabric flaps stopped ~09:30Z but state not fully clean yet. Some BGP adjacencies still flapping.
sara (sre): Action items: 1) continue incremental failover to target regions (next to 50%), 2) notify dedicated customer owners about planned moves, 3) keep cost/egress watch, 4) postmortem owner = alex.
priya (oncall): I'll update the status page and keep this channel pinned. @incident-manager please spin up an incident bridge.
incident-manager: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2345. Incident record created in tracker.
monitoring-bot: :white_check_mark: Latest: api_gateway errors down to ~12% as of 09:34:58Z. Continuing to monitor.
priya (oncall): Good progress. Keep alerts loud here for any regression. If anything spikes, call the bridge and escalate to leadership.
